package domain

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestOnboardingPathExecutionUsesStableHandoffDerivedIDsAndMinimalOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	handoff := OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{HandoffID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", IdempotencyKey: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", RequestHash: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", StateRef: StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, DialogID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TeacherJobID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Goal: LearningReadinessGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "programming-foundation-graph-v1"}, ReadinessObservedAt: now, CreatedAt: now}
	first, err := NewOnboardingPathExecution(handoff, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := NewOnboardingPathExecution(handoff, now.Add(time.Hour))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first.ExecutionID != second.ExecutionID || first.StudentCommandID != second.StudentCommandID || first.RequestHash != second.RequestHash {
		t.Fatalf("unstable execution identities: %#v %#v", first, second)
	}
	first.Status = OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists
	out, err := NewOnboardingPathOutcome(first)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if out.CourseID != "" || out.LearningPathID != "" || out.FirstLessonID != "" || out.Status != OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe conflict outcome %#v", out)
	}
}

func TestOnboardingPathOutcomeAllowsOnlyTheFrozenPublicStatuses(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	handoff := OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{HandoffID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", IdempotencyKey: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", RequestHash: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", StateRef: StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, DialogID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TeacherJobID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Goal: LearningReadinessGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "programming-foundation-graph-v1"}, ReadinessObservedAt: now, CreatedAt: now}
	execution, err := NewOnboardingPathExecution(handoff, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, status := range []string{OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists, OnboardingExecutionStateChanged} {
		execution.Status = status
		if _, err := NewOnboardingPathOutcome(execution); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("status %s: %v", status, err)
		}
	}
	execution.Status, execution.CourseID, execution.LearningPathID, execution.FirstLessonID = OnboardingExecutionPathReady, "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	if _, err := NewOnboardingPathOutcome(execution); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("PATH_READY: %v", err)
	}
	execution.CourseID, execution.LearningPathID, execution.FirstLessonID = "", "", ""
	execution.Status, execution.FailureCode = OnboardingExecutionFailed, "DOWNSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE"
	if _, err := NewOnboardingPathOutcome(execution); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("FAILED must not enter public S9 outcome contract")
	}
}
